title: Fewer dead ends for chat clients and tools
summary:
Chat clients and Gemini tools got fewer error paths, `gptimage-large` got a repair, and the community app garden gained n8n-grok.

The gateway now handles OpenAI-compatible clients that append extra path segments instead of returning a 404. Gemini tool calls also avoid 400 errors when parameter schemas contain fields Vertex AI does not support. Model registry lookups now ignore case, and DeepSeek V3.2 uses `deepseek-v3.2` as its registry ID.

A configuration fix addresses image generation failures with `gptimage-large`.

@aikhusus2025-ctrl’s Indonesian-language n8n-grok joined the creative app directory. App submissions now check for matching projects and use a similarity check to catch likely duplicates before they become PRs.
